releaseNotes.message: merge: feat/build-time-version-changelog-and-plan-docs into main
feat: pre-generate version and changelog at build time and document recent requirements in plan.md
merge: feat/city-resize-trade-negotiation-online-replay-and-409-fix into main
feat: resize city pieces, implement human trade offer & negotiation UI with rejection reasons, fix 409 sequence recovery, and enable online game replay viewer
merge: feat/bundle-server-for-production into main
fix(server): pre-bundle server into standalone JS to eliminate runtime esbuild crashes on cPanel
merge: feat/enable-live-websocket-and-reconnect into main
fix(server,web): enable live websocket for catan.d10.ro and same-origin, add auto-reconnect and status indicator
fix: poll game state as a sync fallback when WebSocket is unreachable
feat: keep the screen awake during an active game
fix: don't hardcode WebSocket port 3001 behind a reverse proxy
fix: move tsx to a real dependency so production installs include it
feat: collapse header nav into a hamburger dropdown, add a plain-node entry file
feat: single-process deployment, online-only play, house-rule defaults
feat: real cross-device multiplayer with a gated waiting room
feat: auto-incrementing version badge with release notes
fix: match plain sea tile color to harbor tiles, vary their rotation
fix: explicit steal feedback banner, correct mobile board pan speed
feat: dice roll decides starting player, trade-modal card preview, steal-target colors
feat: animate resource cards flying from the producing hex to the receiving player
feat: per-turn countdown, action feedback banner, resource-gain flash, trade hand visibility
fix: settlement size, road marker placement/stacking, token font, card badge, coastline
fix: double settlement and city icon size on the board
fix: harbor rotation precision, vector number tokens, per-player road art
feat: nautical chart-table visual redesign + fix mobile board dead space
fix: harbor rotation, swap pier lines for vertex markers, upgrade terrain art
feat: real hex-tile port art and fixed (non-random) harbor layout
merge: fix/startup-and-security-audit into main
fix: server startup, CORS/Origin lockdown, request size cap, replay import bug
merge: feat/randomized-board-spiral-letters-single-row-dock into main
feat: randomize board per match, render official A-R spiral letter tokens, and force single-row dock title bar
merge: feat/fix-lobby-button-overlap-sw-and-dock-toggle into main
fix(ui): eliminate lobby button overlap, fix service worker network errors, resolve vite hmr, and keep bottom dock toggle button in title bar
merge: feat/fix-vite-hmr-and-mobile-lobby-responsiveness into main
fix(web): resolve vite hmr websocket network connection and eliminate horizontal overflow cutting off mobile lobby
merge: feat/lobby-mobile-optimization-invite-code-and-sw-fix into main
feat(lobby): unify match start, add invite code & share link, optimize mobile lobby with vertical scroll, fix service worker extension scheme error
merge: feat/mobile-perfect-layout-header-status-grid-cards into main
feat(ui): eliminate left sidebar gap, move turn status to top header, and arrange cards in compact 6-column grid
merge: feat/local-launch-scripts into main
feat(scripts): add one-click start.bat and stop.bat scripts for local gaming
merge: feat/mobile-ui-ux-grid-modal-no-scroll into main
feat(ui): eliminate scrolling, replace left hud with responsive grid modal, center map and position zoom discrete button
merge: feat/mobile-pwa-and-responsive-board into main
feat(web): add mobile PWA support, pinch-to-zoom touch gestures, and responsive fullscreen board layout
Merge branch 'feat/official-spiral-and-ui-refinements' into main
feat(core,web): implement official A-R clockwise spiral board generator, colored cities without circles, larger harbors, and wider single-row bank sidebar
Merge branch 'feat/ui-assets-viewport-and-persistence' into main
feat(web): add poze terrain/harbor/coastline/card sprites, animated dice, saved replays history, and zero-scroll modal viewport
Merge branch 'feat/web-ui-and-replay-viewer' into main
